blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Telecommunications provider Globe Telecom Inc. reported a 96-percent surge in network infrastructure theft through October 2026, warning that the rise in pilferage threatens service reliability across the Philippines. According to Globe’s Reason for Outage (RFO) reports, pilferage-related incident tickets reached 2,616 from January through October, nearly doubling from 1,334 during the same period […]...
